title: A Brave New World
summary:
Trends in long term oil demand can have a profound impact
on the tanker market. In October, three oil analysts published their long-term outlook for the energy industry. The IEA released their annual 'World Energy Outlook', OPEC issued their annual 'World Oil Outlook 2045' and BP announced their new strategy during their investor event, which was accompanied by their 'Energy Outlook 2020 Edition'.
